query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tps_gene_molecules (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  tps_gene_id INT NOT NULL,
  molecule_id INT NOT NULL,
  relationship_type ENUM('produces', 'catalyzes', 'regulates', 'precursor') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'produces',
  confidence_level ENUM('confirmed', 'predicted', 'inferred') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inferred',
  evidence_source VARCHAR(500),
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_gene_molecule (tps_gene_id, molecule_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (tps_gene_id) REFERENCES tps_genes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (molecule_id) REFERENCES molecules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
